leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a basic file storage system interface with core operations.
Construct a hierarchical directory structure to organize files.
Configure metadata storage for files, including size and timestamps.
Apply access control mechanisms to restrict file operations.
Integrate a simple file system with a simulated storage backend.
Manipulate file paths to navigate and resolve locations within the system.
Initialize a file system with a root directory and default permissions.
